verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for a SaaS incident-management platform that stores incident, alert, and transcript data, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents retention periods, configurable retention policies, or deletion or purge capabilities. The security-page authorization claim and the REST API configuration access are adjacent at best and do not show retention or deletion control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
